description: This file contains a PHP class implementation for a Microsoft Visual FoxPro database driver, including connection handling, query modifications, and record set management specific to VFP using ODBC.

classes.name: ADODB_vfp
classes.description: A class extending ADODB_odbc to implement the VFP-specific database driver with methods for handling SQL queries and transaction support particular to Visual FoxPro ODBC.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_vfp
classes.description: A class for managing record sets returned from VFP databases, extending ADORecordSet_odbc, with specialized type mapping and constructor adjustments.

methods.name: ADODB_vfp
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_vfp class, initializing the parent ODBC connection.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Stub method indicating transactions are not supported, returns false.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Quotes and escapes a string for safe use in a VFP SQL statement.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Modifies SQL to include 'TOP' if an 'ORDER BY' clause is present, then delegates to the parent class's SelectLimit method.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Maps VFP-specific field types to generic data types for record set processing.
